artifact_observations.location: Handwritten text on the right page
artifact_observations.reasoning: The handwritten text exhibits classic AI generation artifacts: letters are malformed, inconsistent in baseline, and some characters merge into illegible scribbles. While intended to look like handwriting, it lacks the structural coherence of real human writing, appearing as 'pseudo-text'.

artifact_observations.location: Metal ring mechanism on the left
artifact_observations.reasoning: The metal rings lack precise geometric circularity and consistent thickness. The connection point to the binder spine is vague and slightly melted, lacking the sharp mechanical definition expected of metal hardware.
The lines of the drawn storyboard panels waver and do not maintain strict linear perspective, giving the paper a slightly warped or 'soft' appearance rather than a flat, rigid sheet.
